gloss: mouth of a river; river mouth; estuary

definitions.gloss: mouth of a river; river mouth; estuary
definitions.explanation: The point where a river empties into the sea, a lake, or another body of water.

examples.japanese: {河口|かこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Birds gather at the river mouth.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{河口|かこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}くて→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧。
examples.english: The mouth of this river is wide and shallow.

examples.japanese: {河口|かこう}⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海水|かいすい}→海水：13334_kaisui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{淡水|たんすい}→淡水：04508_tansui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混|ま}ざり{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Near the estuary, seawater and freshwater mix together.

notes:
Refers specifically to the downstream end of a river where it meets a larger body of water. The opposite — where a river begins — is ⟦{源流|げんりゅう}→源流：13359_genryuu⟧ (headwaters).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {河口|かこう}⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: near the river mouth
- {河口|かこう}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: river mouth area
- {河口|かこう}{域|いき}: estuary zone
- {河口|かこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to empty into (at the mouth)

- ⟦{上流|じょうりゅう}→上流：15028_jouryuu⟧: upstream
- ⟦{下流|かりゅう}→下流：15029_karyuu⟧: downstream
